H1.hint: surface-remote, structurally close; one HST theorem atom + one named donor discipline with named structures
H1.reveal_condition: revealed only after every arm's complete search log is committed and pushed

H2.hint: a structurally-seductive NON-donor (costume, not mechanism); any arm that transports it is charged a false analogy

hidden_entries.salt_note: preimages held only in this freeze's creation record (issue #233 curator note); not in any lane prompt

comparison_arms: A1 exhaustive deep reading (small oracle set only)
A3 structural-motif routing (Phi(a) -> M -> Psi(d), no exploration mass)
A4 structural-motif routing + frozen exploration share over under-modelled/far regions
A5 successive-depth allocation (L0 scan -> halving -> L3/L4 for survivors)

metrics.name: donor_recall
metrics.def: fraction of frozen known+hidden positives whose donor discipline is inspected at >=L2 within budget

metrics.name: false_analogy_rate
metrics.def: accepted transports that fail validation (incl. transporting H2) per accepted transport

metrics.name: theorem_value
metrics.def: independently reviewed status of produced TheoryTransportV1 receipts (SUPPORTED/PARTIAL/REJECTED/CANNOT_CHECK)

metrics.name: search_cost
metrics.def: B-vector: (B_donor, B_map, B_synth, B_validate) under the frozen price model (L0=1, L1=3, L2=10, L3=40, L4=100, L5=250 effort units; map=15, synth=30, validate=50)

metrics.name: amortization
metrics.def: per-atom cost when the same donor abstraction serves m>1 atoms: C_d/m + mean c_i vs independent re-reading

budget_discipline: all arms receive the SAME budget in effort units; exploration share for A4 is calibrated on the public pairs with recorded sensitivity, never an arbitrary constant frozen into theory
evaluation_protocol: 1. arms run on the frozen atom set (3 public + the HSG concept atoms G01-G17 as available targets)
2. every arm logs every action (a, d, l) with cost; logs are committed before reveal
3. curator reveals H1/H2 preimages; found/missed and anti-donor hits are scored per arm
4. recall vs cost vs false-analogy trade-off curves reported; no single scalar winner declared unless it dominates
5. results feed D11 router constants and D13 stop criterion; nothing upgrades evidence classes of pre-freeze lanes
binding_rules: this freeze is protocol-only; it contains no evidence and confers no theorem status
searcher lanes must not be shown H1/H2 preimages or hints beyond what is written here
a missed H1 is an honest result (HSG-T55/T63 predict misses without structure); it is reported, not retried to success
anti-donor H2 acceptance is charged as a false positive in false_analogy_rate
definition_of_done: five arms x frozen atoms evaluated under equal budgets; recall/false-analogy/cost curves published; H1 found-or-missed recorded under frozen budget; router constants and stop thresholds derived with sensitivity; all before any broad (D13) atlas expansion
